_about: The Editor's links as the page asks them, one way for Wraithguard and the viewer: run by tests/test_link_cases.py (gui/editorlink.py's handlers) and viewer-shell/editcore/tests/cases.rs (editcore::links). Each case is a load order (`plugins`, each with its masters and records) and operations: ["link", name, body] and ["journal", document] (the shared journal written as the other side writes it; null removes it). A new reference's editor name is a label (U1...) in requests and answers; editRevision's `rev` is each side's own count and is left out. `expect` is what each gave and the journal after them. Generated from the Python side when a case is added, and read by hand.
